caption: The drawing features a cylindrical pottery jar with a slightly flared rim and a flat base, positioned upright against a plain, light beige background. The jar is primarily light blue in color, with some areas of beige and brown discoloration, indicating stains, wear, or firing marks. A darker blue horizontal band encircles the top portion of the jar, with the embossed text "PAUL::CUSHN" partially visible in the band. The rim has a slightly darker brown interior edge and faint horizontal brown lines near the top. There are patches of darker marks and small spots distributed across the surface of the jar, as well as a prominent vertical streak of brown and beige irregularity on the body. The composition is centered, with the entire jar depicted in full view and no additional objects included.
